[[File:2026 World Championship - 20261023 190054.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Team tournament, 23 October 2026.]]
The '''2026 World Championship Team Tournament''' was the Friday constructed team event at the [[2026 World Championship]] in Bloomington, Minnesota, on 23 October 2026.<ref name="sched">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=86982 2026 World Championship Schedule of Events], Star Wars CCG Players Committee forum, Chris Schoenthal (imrahil327) (14 September 2026). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114004451/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t86982.html Internet Archive].</ref> Eleven teams of two entered. [[Phil Aasen]] and [[Brian Fred]] won as The Unholy Alliance, 12 (+92) without dropping a game, and took the mini obelisk trophies.<ref name="team">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=87034 Team Tournament updates], Star Wars CCG Players Committee forum, Chris Schoenthal (imrahil327) (23 October 2026). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114010607/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t87034.html Internet Archive].</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' Hyatt Regency Bloomington by Mall of America, Bloomington, Minnesota
* '''Date:''' 23 October 2026 (registration 6:30 p.m., start 7:00 p.m.)<ref name="sched" />
* '''Structure:''' three Swiss games; each team has one Dark Side player and one Light Side player for all three games; ranking by cumulative differential<ref name="sched" />
* '''Teams:''' 11<ref name="team" />
* '''Entry:''' $10 per team, included in the Worlds weekend pass<ref name="sched" />
* '''Decklists:''' not required<ref name="sched" />

The schedule allowed a final confrontation after the Swiss games.<ref name="sched" /> The posted results are three Swiss rounds.<ref name="team" />
